competitions.result: Runners-up — lost 2–1 to Manchester United at Wembley.
Second round — lost a replay 1–0 at West Bromwich Albion after a 1–1 home draw.
Winners — beat Borussia Mönchengladbach 3–1 in Rome.

in.note: Signed in May 1977; his first-team debut came the following season.

overview: Liverpool retained the First Division title and won the European Cup for the first time. Bob Paisley’s team finished one point above Manchester City, then beat Borussia Mönchengladbach 3–1 in Rome on 25 May. Terry McDermott, Tommy Smith and Phil Neal scored the goals that brought the European Cup to Anfield.

The FA Cup final had ended in a 2–1 defeat by Manchester United just four days before the victory in Rome. Liverpool also won the Charity Shield, beating Southampton 1–0, although West Bromwich Albion eliminated them in a League Cup second-round replay.

Kevin Keegan was the leading scorer with 20 goals in all competitions. David Johnson joined from Ipswich Town during the summer, while Alan Hansen was signed from Partick Thistle in May. In Europe, Liverpool overturned a first-leg defeat against Saint-Étienne with a 3–1 win at Anfield before beating Zürich in the semi-final.

events.title: Saint-Étienne overcome
events.detail: A 3–1 win at Anfield overturned a 1–0 first-leg defeat in the European Cup quarter-final.

events.title: European champions
events.detail: McDermott, Smith and Neal scored in a 3–1 final win over Borussia Mönchengladbach.
